errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not contain categories labeled "1-5 Силно съгласен". It contains hierarchical categories: four age groups (19-25, 26-34, 35-44, 45+), each subdivided by gender (Жена, Мъж). The labels "1 Силно съгласен", etc., are from the legend and represent the different colored bars, not the x-axis categories.
The vertical axis range is from 0% to 60%, not 50%.
The major gridlines and labels on the y-axis are at intervals of 10% (0%, 10%, 20%, etc.), not 5%.
The lowest value shown on the chart is 0%, which appears for multiple categories (e.g., Жена 45+ for 'Силно съгласен' and 'По-скоро съгласен'). Therefore, 11% is not the lowest value.
The first age group on the x-axis is labeled "19 - 25", not "19-23".

errors.evidence: The colors of the bars do not differentiate between age groups and genders. They represent the five different survey responses as defined in the legend (1 Силно съгласен, 2 По-скоро съгласен, etc.).

The description fails to explain the legend, which is crucial for understanding the chart. It does not state what each of the five colors (light blue, orange, grey, yellow, dark blue) represents (the levels of agreement/disagreement).
The description omits two of the five colors used in the chart: grey (for "Не мога да преценя") and dark blue (for "Силно несъгласен").

The description fails to clearly state that the chart uses a grouped bar structure, where for each demographic sub-group (e.g., Women 19-25), there is a group of five bars representing the distribution of answers.
